sources.title: Rethinking Vision Transformers for MobileNet Size and Speed
sources.snippet: For example, MobileViT [58] is parameter efficient while being times slower than lightweight CNNs [66, 69]. EfficientFormer [47] wields ultra-fast speed on mobile, but the model size is enormous. LeViT [25] and MobileFormer [13] achieve favorable FLOPs at the cost of redundant parameters.
